articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Brandschutz in der Schweiz: Aber doch nicht bei uns
articles.teaser: Die Schweiz plante, den Brandschutz zu lockern. Nun zeigt sich, dass der ausgebrannte Club von Crans-Montana seit 2019 nicht mehr geprüft wurde – und alles ist anders.
articles.image_title: Brandschutz in der Schweiz: This photograph shows the entrance of the bar Le Constellation where a fire ripped through the venue during New Year's Eve celebrations in the Alpine ski resort town of Crans-Montana killing around 40 people and injuring more than 100 others, in Crans-Montana on January 2, 2026. Investigators raced on January 2, 2026 to identify the victims of a fire that ripped through a bar in the Swiss Alps town of Crans-Montana, turning a New Year's celebration into one of the country's worst tragedies. Frederic Gisler, police commander in the Wallis canton in southwestern Switzerland, told reporters that authorities had counted "around 40 people who have died and around 115 injured, most of them seriously". (Photo by MAXIME SCHMID / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Winter in Europa: In Amsterdam und Paris fallen Hunderte Flüge wegen Schnees aus
articles.teaser: Am Flughafen Amsterdam-Schiphol wurden über 700 Flüge wegen Schnees gestrichen. Auch in Frankreich ist der Verkehr durch den Winter beeinträchtigt.
articles.image_title: Winter in Europa: TOPSHOT - A skier skies past the Eiffel Tower at the Champ de Mars covered in snow, following snowfalls in Paris, on January 7, 2026. All buses in Paris and the surrounding region gradually stopped running at around 7am due to renewed snowfall in the area and returned to their depots, according to announcements by Ile-de-France Mobilités (IDFM) and RATP. Snow and ice are affecting northern and western France, a phenomenon of "rare magnitude in the current climate" according to Meteo-France, which is expected to cause significant restrictions on roads and air transport. (Photo by Ludovic MARIN / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.image_title: Schusswaffengewalt: PROVIDENCE, RHODE ISLAND - DECEMBER 14: People pause outside of the engineering and physics building at Brown University, the site of a mass shooting yesterday that left at least two people dead and nine others injured, on December 14, 2025 in Providence, Rhode Island. A suspect in the shooting was detained overnight at a hotel in a nearby community following a manhunt across the prestigious university and the greater Providence area. The shooting took place around 4 p.m. on Saturday as students were preparing for exams and the holiday break. (Photo by Spencer Platt/Getty Images)

articles.title: Stromausfall Berlin: S-Bahnen in Berliner Südwesten fahren nach Stromausfall wieder
articles.teaser: Die Versorgung von drei S-Bahnhöfen sowie aller vom Stromausfall betroffenen Pflegeheime ist wiederhergestellt. Weiterhin sind 25.500 Haushalte in Berlin ohne Strom.
articles.image_title: Stromausfall Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 4: A police line at the entrance to the closed Mexicoplaz S-Bahn train station, during power outage, following an arson attack on power cables on January 4, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack on the cables happened at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal caused a blackout affecting approximately 45,000 residents as well as local businesses, hospitals and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. The Stromnetz Berlin utility company has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents but others will likely have to wait much longer to be reconnected . According to police, the perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning, the incident is similar to a previous attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)
